similar.text: I'm glad to see you again.

Underwater#001.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that our fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#001.dst: Но недавно в обломках открылась небольшая дыра. Говорят, внутри спрятано наше богатство.

Underwater#002.src: Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#002.dst: Поговори с Omango к северу от {p} на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#003.src: Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
Underwater#003.dst: Привет, я Omango. Живу в деревне {p} на вершине холма.
Underwater#003.speaker: Omango

Underwater#004.src: As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
Underwater#004.dst: Как ты знаешь, наш народ пришёл на ваши земли много лет назад, и вот корабль, на котором он плыл.
Underwater#004.speaker: Omango

Underwater#005.src: They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
Underwater#005.dst: Они привезли много роскошных товаров. Большая часть пропала при крушении.
Underwater#005.speaker: Omango

Underwater#006.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#006.dst: Но недавно в обломках открылась небольшая дыра. Говорят, внутри спрятано богатство.
Underwater#006.speaker: Omango

Underwater#007.src: Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
Underwater#007.dst: Увы, никто не смог туда проникнуть. Слишком глубоко, под водой столько не продержаться!
Underwater#007.speaker: Omango

Underwater#008.src: However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
Underwater#008.dst: Но мой старый друг Sayrr - рыбак, и я знаю, что у него есть особый шлем...
Underwater#008.speaker: Omango

Underwater#009.src: If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
Underwater#009.dst: Уговоришь его отдать шлем и найдёшь сокровище - дам тебе долю!
Underwater#009.speaker: Omango

Underwater#010.src: Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Underwater#010.dst: Sayrr на своей лодке, но пещера рядом со мной - короткий путь туда, где он рыбачит. Только в пути береги себя.
Underwater#010.speaker: Omango

Underwater#011.src: When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
Underwater#011.dst: Когда получишь шлем, обыщи корабль и принеси мне [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Удачи.
Underwater#011.speaker: Omango

Underwater#012.src: Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
Underwater#012.dst: Пройди через пещеру на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] и найди Sayrr на лодке с другой стороны

Underwater#013.src: Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
Underwater#013.dst: Чего так смотришь? Потому что я мелкий, а? Да будет тебе известно, я ловил рыбу вдвое больше тебя!
Underwater#013.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#014.src: ...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
Underwater#014.dst: ...ну, раньше ловил. Нынче не клюёт- стоп, а чего тебе в моей лодке надо, чужак?
Underwater#014.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#015.src: Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
Underwater#015.dst: Ага! Да, старый дыхательный шлем у меня остался. Хочешь его? Сперва сделай кое-что для меня.
Underwater#015.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#016.src: I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
Underwater#016.dst: Говорю же, рыба тут больше не клюёт! А жить мне на что-то надо! В той пещере есть рыба, но...
Underwater#016.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#017.src: ...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
Underwater#017.dst: ...там опасновато. Вот что: дам тебе удочку, а ты наловишь мне там, скажем, [{~} Gudgeon Meat].
Underwater#017.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#018.src: The helmet will be all yours after that.
Underwater#018.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#019.src: Bring back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr
Underwater#019.dst: Принеси Sayrr [{~} Gudgeon Meat] из пещеры на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#020.src: Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
Underwater#020.dst: А! С возвращением! Ну как рыбка?
Underwater#020.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#021.src: Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
Underwater#021.dst: Отлично, премного благодарен. Вот твой шлем, развлекайся.
Underwater#021.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#022.src: Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#022.dst: Обыщи разбитый корабль в поисках утерянного сокровища на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#023.src: Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#023.dst: Разбей ящик и отнеси [{~} Old Treasure] Omango на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#024.src: You got it! You found the treasure!
Underwater#024.speaker: Omango

Underwater#025.src: As promised, here's your part of the loot.
Underwater#025.dst: Как обещал, вот твоя доля добычи.
Underwater#025.speaker: Omango
